C-FILE-POSITION-MEMORY.IntentSummary: The caret moved only by arrow keys survives tab switching (a guarded store write on selectionChange that never touches the contentRevision guard), and every file with a pathname remembers its last cursor position (line/ch) and scroll offset on disk through a tableLayoutStore-pattern prefs store — writes coalesced to one per 1.5 s plus close/quit flushes, restore through the single open funnel with a renderer-side clamp — so closing a tab, reopening a file and relaunching the app return the reader to where they were. The owner-report probe scenarios become e2e gates.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: store/editor.js updateCursorPosition(id, cursor) writes tab.cursor only (anchor+focus shape) and ignores junk/unknown ids; contentRevision, history, markdown and isSaved never move. editor.vue's selectionChange subscription calls it after the mirror guard when renderedTabId === currentFile.id, with editor.value.getCursor() (block-key cursor, no export), and arms the flush.

prefs key filePositions; entries {scrollTop ≥ 0, muyaIndexCursor {anchor{line,ch}, focus{line,ch}} | null, savedAt}; sanitizeEntry drops everything else (numbers only — C-8); cap 200 newest; prune-on-load with injectable stat (missing capability keeps entries); moveFileEntry + moveFilePositionsEntry; clampEntryToMarkdown clamps line/ch into the loaded markdown and leaves scrollTop to the browser clamp. MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY from day one.

T-003.Title: Recorder wiring: debounce, close, quit, rename (C-7/C-9)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: editor.vue POSITION_FLUSH_DEBOUNCE_MS=1500 debounce computes muyaIndexCursor ONCE at flush (getMuyaIndexCursor) and calls SAVE_ACTIVE_FILE_POSITION; the scroll handler arms the same flush; the timer dies on unmount. store: SAVE_ACTIVE_FILE_POSITION uses the fresh cursor or the stored value; FORCE_CLOSE_TAB flushes before the splice; _saveSessionState flushes every pathname tab; RENAME and RENAME_IF_NEEDED move the entry beside moveTableLayoutsEntry.

T-004.Title: Restore leg in the open funnel (D-4, C-3/C-4/C-5)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: NEW_TAB_WITH_CONTENT becomes async (the single bootstrap-ipc caller is fire-and-forget): for pathname tabs, await loadFilePosition, clampEntryToMarkdown against the loaded markdown, set docState.scrollTop/muyaIndexCursor before selection/push; the existing activation machinery applies them (setMarkdown muyaIndexCursor branch + scrollToCords); the parallel file-loaded render cannot stomp the restore (identical-markdown early return skips the cursor). Untitled/guide tabs never persist.

Unit: file-position-store.test.js (transforms/clamp/cap/prune/move/schema) + editor-position-memory.test.js (no-revision-drift, flush boundaries, rename moves, restore leg). E2E gates from the owner-report probes: arrows/switch, close+reopen, reload+session-restore relaunch, stale-entry clamp, burst coalescing. Affected call-site tests awaited for the async action; graph M-011 narrative + verification scenario-77-file-position-memory; grace lint zero findings for this bundle.

Verification.Command: npx vitest run tests/renderer && npx playwright test tests/e2e/position-memory.spec.ts tests/e2e/live-reload-scroll.spec.ts --project=chromium

C-1.Name: Arrows survive tab switch
C-1.Expected: Click P10, 80×ArrowDown to P90, switch away and back: caret reads Paragraph 90, scrollTop within 2px of the pre-switch value, and the typed character lands in «Paragraph 90…».

C-2.Name: No revision drift
C-2.Expected: 100 pure cursor moves grow tab.contentRevision by 0, never flip isSaved, and dispatch no muya 'change'; pinned as updateCursorPosition writes only tab.cursor.

C-3.Name: Close and reopen returns
C-3.Expected: Scroll deep with the caret at P120, close the tab, reopen: scrollTop within ±50px of the pre-close value and the typed character lands in «Paragraph 120…».

C-4.Name: Relaunch returns; no double-render stomp
C-4.Expected: After page reload with addBlankTab:true boot (session restore), the reopened file shows the pre-reload scrollTop and caret; the parallel file-loaded render skips instead of resetting.

C-5.Name: Stale entry clamps
C-5.Expected: An entry from a longer revision (line 9999, scrollTop 99999) opened on a shorter file: caret on a real block, scrollTop ≤ maxScroll, no exception, no blank viewport.

C-6.Name: File identity
C-6.Expected: Both Mark rename paths move the entry; a deleted file's entry is pruned on the next load-with-stat; the store never grows past the 200 cap (newest kept).

C-7.Name: Flush beats debounce
C-7.Expected: A tab closed immediately after a scroll persists the final offset (close flush before the splice, verified live with {3778, line 240}); a crash loses at most 1.5s of position; the residual ≤100ms muya scroll debounce is accepted.

C-8.Name: Nothing but numbers
C-8.Expected: The persisted JSON contains only scrollTop/line/ch/savedAt keyed by pathname — sanitizeEntry strips junk (markdown, selectionText); no new IPC commands.

C-9.Name: Per-event cost ~zero
C-9.Expected: During a 30-keyup navigation burst: zero filePositions prefs writes; after the 1.5s window: at most one; getMuyaIndexCursor runs once per flush only.

C-10.Name: Silent and unchanged elsewhere
C-10.Expected: Zero new notice.notify sites; a never-opened file keeps the default state (no entry → no scrollTop/muyaIndexCursor on the tab); untitled/guide tabs never persist.

C-11.Name: Modes and panes
C-11.Expected: Split-view mirror panes never write the source tab's position (mirror guard); muyaIndexCursor is the mode-neutral line/ch representation muya itself uses for source-mode cursor restore.

C-12.Name: Probes become gates
C-12.Expected: 4801 renderer tests pass (0 failed), 5 e2e gates pass, grace lint reports zero findings referencing this bundle's files.

Correctness.Note: F1 (blocker): the draft's muya keyup→dispatchChange idea routes through LISTEN_FOR_CONTENT_CHANGE and would inflate tab.contentRevision (the stale-save-outcome guard) plus a full ExportMarkdown per navigation — replaced with the guarded store write (D-1/D-2). F2: the parallel file-loaded render could stomp the restored caret — the identical-markdown early return is now a task assertion verified live in the C-4 gate. F3: muya's setMarkdown ignores addCursorToMarkdown isValid:false — renderer-side clamp added (D-4). F4: close-inside-debounce would lose the final position — flush-on-close and flush-in-_saveSessionState; residual ≤100ms muya scroll debounce accepted and documented.

Security.Note: Pathname keys are the same data class as tableLayouts/lastSessionTabs; payload numbers-only pinned by sanitizeEntry tests; existing mt::prefs IPC, no backend change.

UX.Note: Externally-edited files restore approximately (clamped); silent restore, no settings surface, first-open behavior unchanged.

Perf.Note: F7: getMuyaIndexCursor runs ExportMarkdown per call — forbidden on the per-event path; computed once per flush/close/quit (D-2), pinned by the C-9 burst gate.
